title: X.509v3 attestation cert profile spec
description: Define the X.509v3 certificate profile for LICHEN node attestation. Fields: Ed25519 subject public key, SAN encoding for Yggdrasil /128 address, custom extension OID for mesh role (relay/leaf/gateway), validity period convention, issuer distinguished name convention. Profile must be minimal enough that any CA can issue interoperable certs. Output: spec addendum to §8.13.2 and/or standalone cert profile document. Reference: JDF cert profile concept from futurism doc.
close_reason: Added X.509v3 LICHEN node attestation certificate profile with Ed25519 SPKI, upstream Yggdrasil /128 SAN binding, role extension, validity, issuer, key usage, and chain verification requirements. Three delegated reviews completed; follow-up findings filed as Beads.
